ChangelogPage.title: Changelog
ChangelogPage.description: See the latest features, improvements, and fixes on Headhunt.cc.
ChangelogPage.currentReleaseTitle: More Practical Imports, Backups, and Profiles

importPrivacy.title: Import URL Privacy Controls
importPrivacy.description: Saving import URLs and including them in exported files are now optional, disabled by default, and manageable for each profile.

webImport.title: Web Import on Every Device
webImport.description: History can now be imported from the official page using a bookmark, with automatic server selection and tailored guidance for non-Windows devices.

backupRestore.title: More Consistent Backup and Restore
backupRestore.description: Backup files can now be restored with drag and drop, while data comparison and existing saved URLs continue to be handled safely.

profileManagement.title: Faster Profile Switching
profileManagement.description: The active profile can now be switched directly from the sidebar, with management for up to three profiles to keep data compact.

notifications.title: Clearer Process Status
notifications.description: Import, sync, backup, and restore now use more consistent, responsive, and easier-to-understand notifications.

openSource.title: Now Open Source
openSource.description: The project is now public on GitHub with contribution guidelines, automated quality checks, security reporting, direct repository navigation, and build links to the exact source commit.

ChangelogPage.latestReleaseTitle: Clearer Tracking, Sharing, and Site Insights

headhuntResults.title: More Accurate Headhunt Results
headhuntResults.description: Recent results now show clearer win and loss indicators, with weapon descriptions tailored to banners that do not use character rotation rules.

mobileNavigation.title: Smoother Mobile Navigation
mobileNavigation.description: Mobile links, overlay back navigation, recent result headers, rarity filters, and import guidance now behave more consistently.

socialPreviews.title: Dynamic Social Preview Images
socialPreviews.description: Open Graph and X preview images now feature all active banners, including character artwork from Chartered Headhunting rotations.

trackerNavigation.title: Improved Tracker Entry
trackerNavigation.description: Opening a banner from Home scrolls to its target, while regular Tracker navigation starts at the top and keeps banner spacing aligned with the sidebar.

analytics.title: Google Analytics Integration
analytics.description: Website usage statistics now help guide improvements to content, performance, and features without collecting personal tracker data.

legalPages.title: Localized Legal Information
legalPages.description: Privacy Policy and Terms of Service are now available in English and Indonesian, with clearer details about Analytics and Google Drive data handling.

ChangelogPage.newReleaseTitle: A More Reliable and Polished Headhunt.cc

trackerNavigation.title: Banner Navigation
trackerNavigation.description: All banner types are now grouped in a scrollable sidebar, with permanent banners placed after the active banners.

trackerStatistics.title: Contextual Statistics
trackerStatistics.description: Statistic explanations now adapt to each banner's free pull, Guaranteed, Rate-Up, and Rotate rules.

driveRestore.title: Safer Google Drive Restore
driveRestore.description: Restoring a Drive backup no longer creates an unnecessary new backup, and completion appears as a global notification.

interface.title: Interface Improvements
interface.description: Home, Tracker, Changelog, Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, modals, and mobile navigation received consistency and usability improvements.

branding.title: Refreshed Site Identity
branding.description: The header logo, favicon, app icons, and web manifest artwork now share a consistent visual identity.

homepage.title: Refined Homepage Introduction
homepage.description: The homepage introduction is now centered and separated more clearly from shortcuts, while the mobile header adapts better to narrow screens.

cloudBackup.title: Google Drive Backup
cloudBackup.description: Automatic backups, cross-device synchronization, version history, restore, and a persistent Google session.

localBackup.title: Local Backup
localBackup.description: Download and restore all data through JSON, with validation and data comparison before restoring.

profiles.title: Profile Management
profiles.description: Add, rename, select, and delete profiles with a safer and clearer confirmation flow.

importV2.title: Tracker Import V2
importV2.description: More reliable imports with legacy data migration, destination profile selection, and profile-safe synchronization.

statistics.title: Clearer Statistics
statistics.description: Statistics now share one calculation source and every value includes an explanation, including AVG Pity, Guaranteed, and free pull rules.

interface.title: Interface Refresh
interface.description: Settings and Import menus, modals, tabs, tooltips, buttons, and empty states are now more consistent and comfortable to use.

WebSteps.securityTitle: Your login stays on the official website
WebSteps.securityDescription: The bookmark reads the temporary gacha token locally and does not read or send your password. You can review its complete code before using it.
WebSteps.openRecordBookDesc: Open the official GRYPHLINE Record Book on this device, log in, select your Endfield character, then keep that page open.
WebSteps.createBookmarkDesc: Copy the bookmark code below. Bookmark any page, edit that bookmark, and replace its address with the copied code. On mobile, edit it from your browser's bookmark manager.
WebSteps.runBookmarkDesc: While still on the official Record Book, open the import bookmark. Once it reports success, return here and paste the copied URL below. Your server is detected automatically during import.

WindowsSteps.openHeadHuntingDesc: Launch <game>Arknights: Endfield</game>, then open <menu>Headhunting Details</menu> so its history URL can be detected.
WindowsSteps.openPowerShellDesc: Press the <key>Windows</key> key, search for “PowerShell”, then launch <app>Windows PowerShell</app>.
WindowsSteps.runCommandDesc: Copy the command below into <app>Windows PowerShell</app>, then press <key>Enter</key>. Once the URL appears, it will be copied to your clipboard automatically. Paste it into the import field below.
WindowsSteps.reviewScript: Review the full script on GitHub

MobileSteps.securityDescription: This method uses a local VPN and CA certificate to inspect HTTPS requests on your device. Enable it only while obtaining the URL, never share the URL you find, and remove the certificate afterward.
MobileSteps.cleanupTitle: Stop capture and remove the certificate

AndroidSteps.installDescription: Use the official Reqable app from Google Play. Do not use modified APKs or apps from unknown links.
AndroidSteps.setupDescription: Open Reqable, choose Standalone or Local Mode, then follow its prompts to allow the local VPN and install its CA certificate. If available, limit capture to Arknights: Endfield only.
AndroidSteps.captureDescription: Open Endfield and go to Headhunting, but do not open Details yet. Start capture in Reqable, return to the game, then open Details or Records to load your gacha history. Stop capture after the page appears.
AndroidSteps.copyDescription: In Reqable's request list, find the ef-webview.gryphline.com host. Open the GET request whose path is /api/record/char, then use Copy URL or Share to copy the complete URL. Return here and paste it into the Import URL field.
AndroidSteps.cleanupDescription: Make sure Reqable capture and its VPN are stopped. Open Android security settings, locate User credentials or user-installed certificates, and remove the Reqable certificate if you no longer need it.
AndroidSteps.fallback: No request appears or the game reports a network error? Some Android versions do not trust user certificates. Do not root your device or install a modified APK; use the Web or Windows method instead.

IOSSteps.installTitle: Install Stream from the App Store
IOSSteps.installDescription: Install Stream – Network Debug Tool from the App Store. It records requests locally on your iPhone or iPad.
IOSSteps.openStore: Open Stream in the App Store
IOSSteps.setupDescription: In Stream, tap Sniff Now and allow the VPN configuration. Choose Install CA. After downloading the profile, open Settings > General > VPN & Device Management, install Stream Generated CA, then go to Settings > General > About > Certificate Trust Settings and enable trust for it.
IOSSteps.captureDescription: Open Endfield and go to Headhunting, but do not open Details yet. Return to Stream and tap Sniff Now, then go back to Endfield and open Details or Records. Once the history appears, return to Stream and tap Stop Sniffing.
IOSSteps.copyDescription: Open Sniff History and select the newest capture. Choose Group by Host, open ef-webview.gryphline.com, then select the GET /api/record/char request. In Request, press and hold that request and choose Copy URL. Return here and paste the complete URL.
IOSSteps.cleanupDescription: Turn off Stream sniffing and its VPN. After copying the URL, open Settings > General > VPN & Device Management, select Stream Generated CA, and remove the profile if you no longer need it.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.text: Welcome to {appName}. Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle your data when you use our website.

dataCollection.title: 2. Data Collection
dataCollection.server: {appName} does not maintain a user account database or permanently store your gacha history on our servers.
dataCollection.local: All application data, such as gacha history, pity records, or imported data, is stored locally in your browser.

localStorage.title: 3. Local Storage
localStorage.intro: We use your browser’s local storage to:
localStorage.url: Save your gacha import URL only when you select the save option during import
localStorage.history: Save your gacha history and pity tracking data
localStorage.details: Your history and any import URL you choose to save remain in the browser on your device. Import URLs are not saved by default. You can delete local data at any time by clearing your browser data.
localStorage.export: Local backup files do not include import URLs by default. A saved import URL is included only when you specifically select that option before downloading the backup. Restoring a file without URLs does not overwrite URLs already stored in the browser.

token.title: 4. Token Usage
token.text: Your gacha URL or token is used to request roll history from game-related endpoints and is never permanently stored on our servers. With the Web method, the bookmark reads only the temporary gacha token from the official site's session storage to create an import URL; it does not read your password. The URL is saved in your browser only if you select the save option during import.

drive.title: 5. Google Drive Backup
drive.backup: If you connect Google Drive, backup data is sent directly from your browser to the application data folder in your Google Drive. A backup may contain your profiles, gacha records, statistics, and an import URL that you previously chose to save. If no import URL is saved, the backup does not contain that URL or token.
drive.permission: We request the limited Google Drive application-data permission. The short-lived Google access token is kept in browser memory and is not stored in local storage or included in backup files. If you choose to stay connected, a Google refresh token is stored in a secure, HTTP-only cookie so the website can restore your session. You can disconnect or revoke access at any time.

analytics.title: 6. Google Analytics
analytics.collection: We use Google Analytics 4 to understand how visitors use the website and to improve its content, performance, and features. Google Analytics may collect information such as pages visited, interactions, approximate location, browser and device details, referring pages, and session information through cookies or similar identifiers. Your browser may also transmit your IP address to Google as part of the request.
analytics.processing: We use Google Analytics only to collect website usage statistics. We have not configured Google Analytics to collect your gacha history, import URL or token, Google Drive backup contents, or email address. Google processes the analytics data it collects according to its own terms and privacy practices.
analytics.googleDataLink: Learn how Google uses information from sites that use its services.

cookies.title: 7. Cookies and Your Choices
cookies.text: {appName} uses cookies or browser storage for essential functionality, preferences, Google Drive connectivity, and website analytics. You can restrict or delete cookies through your browser settings, although doing so may affect some features.
cookies.optOutIntro: Where supported, you can also use the

thirdParty.title: 8. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.text: We use third-party services such as Google Analytics, Google Drive, game-related endpoints, and content delivery networks. Data handled by those services is subject to their respective privacy policies.

changes.title: 9. Changes to This Policy
changes.text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be reflected on this page.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.text: By accessing or using {appName}, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

description.title: 2. Description of the Service
description.text: {appName} is an independent tool for importing, displaying, analyzing, backing up, and restoring Arknights: Endfield gacha history. Features may change, be suspended, or be discontinued at any time.

drive.title: 3. Google Account and Drive Backups
drive.access: Google Drive integration is optional. If you connect a Google account, you authorize {appName} to create, update, read, and manage its own backup files and backup history in the application data folder of your Google Drive.
drive.responsibility: You are responsible for selecting the correct Google account and protecting access to it. You may disconnect Google Drive at any time from the application or revoke access through your Google Account settings.

responsibilities.title: 4. User Responsibilities
responsibilities.lawful: Use the service only for lawful, personal purposes.
responsibilities.account: Use import methods, including the Web method, only with an account you own or are lawfully authorized to access, and comply with the applicable terms of third-party services.
responsibilities.abuse: Do not abuse, disrupt, or attempt to bypass the service.
responsibilities.private: Keep gacha import URLs and exported backup files private. A backup file may contain an import URL or temporary access token if you choose to include it.
responsibilities.verify: Verify important data before relying on calculated results.

thirdParty.title: 5. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.text: The service interacts with third-party services, including Google Drive and game-related endpoints. Your use of those services is also governed by their respective terms and policies. We do not control their availability, accuracy, or behavior.

intellectualProperty.title: 6. Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.text: The {appName} project code is made available under its repository license. Arknights: Endfield names, images, trademarks, game data, and other third-party materials remain the property of their respective owners and are not licensed by us.

warranties.title: 7. Disclaimer of Warranties
warranties.text: The service is provided “as is” and “as available” without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee uninterrupted access, complete data, accurate calculations, or compatibility with future game or third-party API changes.

liability.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
liability.text: To the fullest extent permitted by law, {appName} and its contributors will not be liable for lost data, account issues, service interruptions, or indirect or consequential damages arising from use of the service.

changes.title: 9. Changes to These Terms
changes.text: We may update these Terms from time to time. The updated date will be shown on this page. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised Terms.

contact.title: 10. Contact
contact.text: Questions about these Terms can be submitted through the project’s official repository or community channels linked by {appName}.
